script.problem: Moment 4's passage 1 Kings 19:19-21 doesn't include a verse that names Abel-meholah in the lessons.

terra.problem: 1 Kings 4:12 describes Baana’s district as extending past Abel-meholah to Jokmeam, so Abel-meholah is not necessarily its edge.
1 Kings 19:20–21 says Elisha asked to kiss his father and mother goodbye, but it does not say whether he did so.
Neither 1 Kings 19:19–21 nor the supplied source establishes that Elisha slaughtered the oxen and gave the meat to the people at Abel-meholah.
